offense_official: Fencer or team member not present upon 1st and then 2nd call. If still not present at 3rd call Elimination from the competition.
one_liner: Fencer or team member absent when called.
explainer: First call: Yellow. Second: Red. Third: elimination.

offense_official: Unwillingness to fight: the sanctions imposed are shown by specific P-cards which are not cumulative with any other sanction awarded.
notes: P-cards not cumulative with any other sanction.
one_liner: Unwillingness to fight (passivity).
explainer: After one minute without a hit or off-target hit, the referee calls Halt. The procedure differs in individual direct-elimination and team bouts; see the breakdown below. P-cards apply only to that bout or match.

offense_official: Leaving the strip without permission
one_liner: Leaving the strip without permission.
explainer: Yellow first; Red for later offenses.

offense_official: Corps à corps to avoid a touch *
one_liner: Body contact to avoid a touch.
explainer: The fencer’s touch is annulled. Yellow first; Red for later offenses.

offense_official: Turning the back to the opponent *
one_liner: Turning your back to your opponent.
explainer: The fencer’s touch is annulled. Yellow first; Red for later offenses.

offense_official: Covering/substitution of valid target *
notes: SOURCE TYPO: printed 't.29,2' with comma; normalized to t.29.2.
one_liner: Covering or substituting valid target.
explainer: The fencer’s touch is annulled. Yellow first; Red for later offenses. Valid target depends on the weapon.

offense_official: Touching/taking hold of electrical equipment *
one_liner: Touching or holding electrical equipment.
explainer: The fencer’s touch is annulled. Yellow first; Red for later offenses.

offense_official: Crossing the side of the strip to avoid being touched *
one_liner: Leaving the side of the strip to avoid a touch.
explainer: The fencer’s touch is annulled. Yellow first; Red for later offenses.

offense_official: Delaying the bout
one_liner: Delaying the bout.
explainer: Yellow first; Red for later offenses.

offense_official: Clothing/equipment not working or not conforming; absence of second regulation weapon or bodycord
one_liner: Equipment does not conform or required spares are missing.
explainer: This entry covers nonconforming or faulty equipment and a missing spare weapon or body cord. Yellow first, then Red.

offense_official: Placing the weapon on the strip to straighten it
one_liner: Placing a weapon on the strip to straighten it.
explainer: Yellow first; Red for later offenses.

offense_official: Bending/dragging weapon point on conductive strip (F,E)
one_liner: Dragging a weapon point on the strip (foil, épée).
explainer: This entry applies to foil and épée. Yellow first, then Red.

offense_official: In sabre, touch scored with the guard *; any forward movement crossing the legs or feet *
one_liner: Illegal guard touch or crossing the feet in sabre.
explainer: The chart lists both offenses for sabre and marks the touch as annulled. Yellow first, then Red.

offense_official: Refusal to obey the Referee
one_liner: Refusing to obey the referee.
explainer: Yellow first; Red for later offenses.

offense_official: Hair not conforming
one_liner: Hair does not conform to the rules.
explainer: See the cited rule for the requirements. Yellow first, then Red.

offense_official: Jostling, disorderly fencing *; taking off mask before the Referee calls “Halt”; undressing on the strip
notes: AUDIT: '*' printed after 'disorderly fencing' — annulment may apply only to that sub-offense, not mask/undressing. Flagged for ref-check.
one_liner: Jostling, disorderly fencing, early mask removal or undressing.
explainer: The chart lists each offense under Group 1. Its asterisk follows ‘disorderly fencing’; check the rule text for when a touch is annulled.

offense_official: Abnormal fencing action *; touches with brutality or an intentional fall to avoid being hit *
one_liner: Abnormal action, brutal touch or deliberate fall.
explainer: The fencer’s touch is annulled. Yellow first; Red for later offenses.

offense_official: Unjustified appeal, casting doubt on the decision of the Referee on a point of fact
one_liner: Unjustified appeal of a decision on a point of fact.
explainer: Yellow for the first offense; Red for later offenses. See the cited rules on appeals.

offense_official: Entering the Strip Enclosure without the Referee’s permission +
notes: + = team special: Special Yellow Card for whole team, valid whole team match; repeat 1st-group offense by any fencer in same match = Red each time.
one_liner: Entering the strip enclosure without permission.
explainer: This is a team penalty: the Yellow applies to the whole team match. A later Group 1 offense by any team member draws Red.

offense_official: Using the non-weapon arm or hand *
one_liner: Using the non-weapon arm or hand.
explainer: The fencer’s touch is annulled. Red.

offense_official: Interruption of bout for medical reason not confirmed by doctor
one_liner: Medical interruption not confirmed by a doctor.
explainer: The chart lists an immediate Red when a doctor does not confirm the medical reason.

offense_official: Absence of equipment control mark *
one_liner: Missing equipment control mark.
explainer: The fencer’s touch is annulled. Red.

offense_official: Intentionally dropping a weapon during the fencing phrase
one_liner: Intentionally dropping a weapon during the phrase.
explainer: Red.

offense_official: Absence of name on back, absence of national colors where required
one_liner: Missing name or required national colors.
explainer: The chart lists an immediate Red for either offense.

offense_official: Deliberate touch not on opponent *
one_liner: Deliberate touch not on the opponent.
explainer: The touch is annulled. Red.

offense_official: Dangerous, violent or vindictive action, blow with guard or pommel *
one_liner: Dangerous action or a blow with the guard or pommel.
explainer: The touch is annulled. Red.

offense_official: Fencer disturbing order on the strip
notes: 2nd-penalty Black cell visually shared across 3 rows (this + dishonest + publicity).
one_liner: Fencer disturbing order on the strip.
explainer: Red first; immediate exclusion is possible in serious cases. A later offense draws Black.

offense_official: Dishonest fencing *
one_liner: Dishonest fencing.
explainer: The fencer’s touch is annulled. Red first; Black for a later offense.

offense_official: Offense against publicity code
notes: Non-t. ref: Fencers' Publicity Code appendix in rules.txt.
one_liner: Offense against the publicity code.
explainer: Red first; a later offense draws Black. See the cited publicity code.

offense_official: Any person not on strip disturbing order; smoking in the competition halls (including with electronic cigarettes)
notes: Includes electronic cigarettes. Applies to non-fencers.
one_liner: Venue disturbance or smoking, including by spectators.
explainer: The entry applies to people not on the strip and includes smoking or vaping in the competition hall. A warning may be followed by expulsion from the venue.

offense_official: Warming up or training without wearing conforming fencing clothing and equipment
one_liner: Training without conforming fencing equipment.
explainer: Warning first; Black for a later offense.

offense_official: Anti-sporting behavior
one_liner: Anti-sporting behavior.
explainer: Red first; Black for a later offense.

offense_official: Fencer equipped with electronic communication equipment permitting the fencer to receive communications during the bout
one_liner: Receiving electronic communication during a bout.
explainer: A device that lets a fencer receive communication during a bout draws Black. See the chart note for the scope of exclusion.

offense_official: Falsified weapon inspection marks, intentional modification of equipment
notes: Range c–e expanded to three refs.
one_liner: Falsified inspection marks or modified equipment.
explainer: Black.

offense_official: Manifest cheating with equipment
one_liner: Manifest cheating with equipment.
explainer: Black.

offense_official: Refusal of a fencer to fence another competitor (individual or team) properly entered
one_liner: Refusing to fence an entered competitor.
explainer: The chart lists Black for refusing to fence an individual or team competitor properly entered in the event.

offense_official: Offense against sportsmanship
one_liner: Offense against sportsmanship.
explainer: Black applies. See chart notes for the scope of exclusion.

offense_official: Refusal of fencer to salute opponent, the referee and the audience at the beginning or at the end of the bout
one_liner: Refusing to salute at the start or end of a bout.
explainer: The chart lists Black for refusing to salute the opponent, referee and audience.

offense_official: Profiting from collusion, favoring an opponent
one_liner: Profiting from collusion or favoring an opponent.
explainer: Black applies. See chart notes for the scope of exclusion.

offense_official: Violent or vindictive actions
one_liner: Violent or vindictive action.
explainer: Black applies. See chart notes for the scope of exclusion.

offense_official: Doping
one_liner: Doping.
explainer: The chart lists Black. See the cited anti-doping rule.
